user.title: Add a TV running TV Kiosk
user.description: On the TV: Settings → Pop-ups and API → Web admin, API address and token.

zeroconf_confirm.title: TV Kiosk found: {name}
zeroconf_confirm.description: Enter the API token of {name} ({host}). On the TV: Settings → Pop-ups and API → Web admin, API address and token.

reauth_confirm.title: New API token
reauth_confirm.description: The TV refused the token (it may have been changed). Enter the current one.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the TV. Check the IP address and port, that TV Kiosk is open and its API is on.

abort.already_configured: This TV is already set up.
abort.not_tv_kiosk: That isn't a TV Kiosk TV.

notify.name: Show a pop-up
notify.description: Shows a pop-up on the TV, over any app: text, a picture or a live camera, a sound, speech and buttons.

image.name: Picture
image.description: A full URL the TV can reach.

camera.name: Live camera
camera.description: A camera to show live while the pop-up is up.

stream.name: Live stream URL
stream.description: Any MJPEG stream, e.g. from go2rtc or Frigate.

duration.name: Seconds
duration.description: Time on screen; 0 stays until closed.

sound.name: Sound
sound.description: chime, doorbell, alert, or a URL.

id.name: ID
id.description: The same ID replaces a pop-up on screen.

actions.name: Buttons
actions.description: Up to 3: label plus navigate, url, event, or toggle (a light, switch, fan, cover, scene or script).

qr.name: QR code
qr.description: Text shown as a QR code, e.g. a guest Wi-Fi login.

countdown.name: Countdown
countdown.description: Seconds counting down in the pop-up.

progress.name: Progress
progress.description: 0-100, a progress bar; resend with the same ID to move it.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: high still shows during Do not disturb (smoke alarm, doorbell).

clear_popup.name: Close a pop-up
clear_popup.description: Closes the pop-up with this ID, or all of them.

navigate.name: Open a Home Assistant page
navigate.description: Opens a dashboard path on the TV without a reload.

return_after.name: Back after
return_after.description: Seconds until the start page comes back; empty stays.

open_url.name: Open a web page
open_url.description: Loads any page on the TV.

url.name: URL
url.description: http:// or https://, or kiosk:planner for the family planner.

return_after.name: Back after
return_after.description: Seconds until the start page comes back; empty stays.

motion.name: Motion
motion.description: Someone was seen: wakes a resting screen. present true holds it awake until present false.

wake.name: Wake
wake.description: Turns the screen on and brings the dashboard to the front, even over another app.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Keeps the night screen away this long.

speak.name: Speak
speak.description: The TV says the text with its own text-to-speech.

play_sound.name: Play a sound
play_sound.description: Plays a sound URL on the TV.

url.name: URL
url.description: A sound the TV can reach.

launch_app.name: Open an app
launch_app.description: Opens another app on the TV.

apply_settings.name: Apply settings
apply_settings.description: Sets the same settings on every TV given (names as in the TV's settings export). Only the settings listed change.

now_playing.name: Show now playing
now_playing.description: A pop-up that follows a media player: artwork, title, artist and progress. It closes by itself 30 seconds after the music stops.

entity.name: Media player
entity.description: For example a Music Assistant player.
